story_title: The Boy Who Sold His Shadow
premise: A poor boy sells his shadow to a mysterious stranger for $100, only to discover that without it, his existence fades from the world—and something far worse was kept at bay.
opening_hook: Never sell something you cannot replace. A starving boy sold his shadow for a hundred dollars.

hook_options.spoken_hook: Never sell something you cannot replace. A starving boy sold his shadow for a hundred dollars.
hook_options.on_screen_text: THE BOY WHO SOLD HIS SHADOW
hook_options.curiosity_gap: Why would anyone buy a shadow, and what happens when you lose it?

on_screen_hook_text: THE BOY WHO SOLD HIS SHADOW

characters.name: The Wanderer
characters.visual_anchor: 2D cartoon stickman boy with smooth warm ivory oval head, two vertical black pill eyes, neutral slit mouth, thin black stick limbs and torso, wearing a brick-red ribbed knit beanie, striped mustard-gold and rust-maroon scarf with fringe, and dark charcoal short-sleeved t-shirt.
characters.motivation: Regain his lost shadow before his existence vanishes completely.

scenes.title: The Alley Bargain
scenes.narration: Never sell something you cannot replace. A starving boy sold his shadow for a hundred dollars.
scenes.visual_description: Vertical 9:16 portrait. The Wanderer boy standing in a cold cobblestone alleyway facing a tall mysterious stranger in a dark brimmed fedora under an amber streetlamp.

scenes.title: The Obsidian Box
scenes.narration: He laughed, thinking it a joke. Until the stranger opened an obsidian box beneath the sun.
scenes.visual_description: Medium 9:16 close-up. The mysterious stranger holds open a small black obsidian box with silver latches. Sunlight blazes down, and the boy silhouette begins to peel from the pavement.

scenes.title: The Missing Silhouette
scenes.narration: The boy stepped forward. The ground behind him was completely, terrifyingly blank.
scenes.visual_description: Full-body 9:16 portrait. The Wanderer boy standing in blinding sunlight. The brick wall and trash bins cast long black shadows, but beneath the boy boots, there is zero shadow.

scenes.title: The Careless Feast
scenes.narration: With cash in hand, he bought warm food, new clothes, and celebrated his easy luck.
scenes.visual_description: Warm interior 9:16 shot. The Wanderer boy sits at a wooden table in a retro diner eating steaming soup, surrounded by shopping bags and paper money.

scenes.title: The Forgotten Son
scenes.narration: Until next morning. His mother stood weeping, looking straight through him like empty air.
scenes.visual_description: Medium 9:16 shot in a shadowy apartment hallway. A woman stands crying with her hands over her face, staring right through the boy as if he is invisible.

scenes.title: The Dissolving Portrait
scenes.narration: In the framed photograph on the wall, his face was dissolving into a smeared void.
scenes.visual_description: Extreme close-up 9:16 framing. A cracked wooden picture frame on wallpaper. In the photograph, the boy face has melted into a blank, smudged white haze.

scenes.title: The Terrified World
scenes.narration: He sprinted outside. His reflection was fading, and his own dog snarled in terror.
scenes.visual_description: Over-the-shoulder 9:16 view on a wet street. A street dog cowers, ears back, barking at the empty air behind the boy. The storefront window reflects only a faint ghostly outline.

scenes.title: The Desperate Beggar
scenes.narration: Desperate, he cornered the stranger in the fog, begging for his shadow back.
scenes.visual_description: Dramatic 9:16 medium two-shot in dense cold blue mist. The Wanderer boy desperately grabs the stranger dark overcoat, holding out the crumpled bank notes.

scenes.title: The Unseen Threat
scenes.narration: The old man smiled cold: You sold your shadow, boy. But you never asked what it was protecting you from.
scenes.visual_description: Low-angle intense 9:16 close-up. The stranger faint smile under the dark brim, while behind him in the swirling mist, a gargantuan monstrous silhouette rises in the dark.
